description: Ministry of Finance - Strategic Development Projects Act No. 14 of 2008 Exemption from Custom Duty under Custom Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an order under the Strategic Development Projects Act that provides customs duty exemptions. It contains a statutory instrument (ministerial order) that modifies the application of the Customs Ordinance for a specific company. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, this is in his capacity as the issuing authority of a legal order, not as a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The core content is regulatory in nature, focusing on customs duty exemptions and legal provisions rather than government structure or personnel changes.
